newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bubbly notionnel aims for 129.86 peak. [CORRECTED 11:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bubbly notionnel aims for 129.86 peak. [CORRECTED 11:10 GMT]

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF have been buoyed by their strong opening on Wednesday and are set to have a run at the 129.86 June high (Corrects from "late May high"), analysts said.

"We've broken above the range, taking us back to the May high at 129.86," Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London said. "Short-term and daily momentum indicators are confirming this."

June notionnel futures were quoted at 129.72, up 0.24 from Tuesday's settlement price as it looked like strong efforts were being made by the French government to have the EMU stability pact ratified by the Amsterdam summit.
Diebel said if 129.86 was broken decisively it would open the way for a test of resistance from a downtrend line from the February and May highs coming in this session around 130.57.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, was also bullish on the contract.

"This morning has seen prices break up again through the recent highs, leaving the consolidation of the last few days looking like a bullish flag pattern, projecting prices higher over the next few days," he said in a research note.
He expected the contract to target the highs around 130.76 from May 16.
To the downside, Diebel said congestion around 129.50 would brake any initial dip but a drop through 129.32 would be more serious. That was the downside limit of the recent congestion.
"If we get through that we're going lower to 129.00 and beyond," Diebel said.

Adcock said he would use short-term pullbacks to 129.54 as a buying opportunity, placing stops under 129.02. Daily charts show the first level as the June 5 high and the second as the low on June 4 before the contract shot higher.
September Pibor were quoted up four basis points at 96.41 at 0807 GMT.
